title: Release of Reward Points Standing on a Circle Membership
content:
## The request this schedule answers

A member asking to spend reward points standing on a Northbeam Circle Membership is dealt with under this
schedule. What it governs is one figure: the points that redemption spends.

## When the points a redemption spends are settled

The points a redemption spends are settled only after the ledger carries an earning entry for every
purchase already billed on the profile.

## What the booking does to the record

The membership ledger gains a redemption entry carrying the points spent, the form the redemption took and the
reference it is being spent against, and the reward point balance shown on the membership drops by those
points. The member sees the points gone from the balance and the redemption standing against the reference
given.

## Whose tool this is and how it is invoked

`redeem_reward_points_8621cafe` is the member's own tool. The desk unlocks it and hands it over, and the
customer themselves runs it to spend the points; the desk does not spend them on the member's behalf.

## Parameters

- `membership_id` — the reference number of the Circle membership whose points are being spent, read from the
  membership record returned when the membership is looked up.
- `points_redeemed` — the points being spent, in whole points, signed, passed as a positive whole number of
  points with no decimal part and no thousands separator; it is stored as an integer count of points at exactly
  that precision and the entry itself carries it as a reduction.
- `redemption_kind` — the form this redemption takes, exactly one of: `reward_certificate`, the points come
  back as a certificate the member spends later; `instant_checkout_discount`, the points come straight off a
  purchase at the till or off a charge already standing on the account, there and then; `charitable_donation`,
  the points go to the retailer's recycling fund; `points_transfer`, the points move to another profile on a
  tier that allows transfers.
- `redemption_ref` — the reference the member reads out for what the points are being spent against, copied
  character for character as they say it, keeping their wording, digits, letter case and punctuation, with
  nothing translated, tidied, shortened, added or dropped.

## What comes back

A confirmation line naming the membership, the points spent, the form it was taken as, the reference it was
spent against and the reference number of the new redemption entry; the presence of that redemption entry
reference is what marks the call as completed.
